synth.notes:
Board = 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours (axis 10, target 11, piece ring 5, reflection ring 4, bg 9); stateless, re-parsed every call.
A1/A2 move the selected axis or piece one block row; A3/A4 move pieces one column (no-op with the axis selected); pieces are blocked by the board edge and other pieces, the axis only by the edge.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size (largest first) -> axis; a merged piece group is split by growing from 0-centre blocks through non-9 centres.
Reflection row = 2A-r (skip the axis row, off-board rows and piece-occupied blocks); layers piece > reflection > target > axis; hole fills: selected piece 0, reflection 4, selected axis dot solid 0.
HUD column 63 changes one 11 to 12 per action that changes the board. Not confirmed: whether a piece can enter the axis row, and the A5 order after the first two pieces.
